PubMed mis-parsed OR chains (two queries returned >19,000 hits) and the unindexed phrase "lamina supraneuroporica" (split into single words); those result sets were discarded.
get_article_metadata output was truncated at about 59 KB for two large batches (only 18 of 40 and 18 of 28 requested PMIDs returned); items not shown were screened by other means or skipped.
get_full_text_article returned an empty full_text for PMC6793052, PMC6826035 and PMC4650131, so those could not be checked.

The chick Pax7-in-paraphysis reference ("Nomura et al.") cited by Bandin 2013 could not be identified or verified; Kawakami 1997 (chick Pax6/Pax7 antibodies, Mech Dev) was not found in PubMed through the tool; neither was recorded.
No ZFIN/Xenbase anatomy-ontology entry for "paraphysis" could be confirmed through WebSearch (only unrelated parapophysis terms); whether such terms exist remains unverified.
Vingert & Gonobobleva 2025 (gecko Correlophus ciliatus) is not indexed in PubMed; it was already held in the corpus from web sources.
WebSearch result counts in the query log are approximate numbers of links returned, not exact hit counts.

records.title: Regional expression of Pax7 in the brain of Xenopus laevis during embryonic and larval development
records.authors: Bandín S, Morona R, Moreno N, González A
records.query: WebSearch: "paraphysis" Pax7 expression amphibian lungfish developing brain choroid plexus telencephalic hemispheres; PMC full-text read
records.excerpt: Interestingly Pax7 expression was described in the paraphysis during development in the chick (Nomura et al.,). The paraphysis was described within the telencephalon because it is located rostral to the velum transversum, which classically marks its dorsal limit with the diencephalon (Warren,), and according to its development it was considered a posterior telencephalic organ adjacent to the choroid plexus of the third ventricle (Kappers,). Therefore, the only telencephalic structure that might express Pax7, at least in some vertebrates, would be the paraphysis.
records.note: Abstract does not name the paraphysis; PMC full text does: weak Pax7 immunoreactivity in the membranous structures between the telencephalic hemispheres that contain the paraphysis (Xenopus, early stages), and discussion that the paraphysis is the only telencephalic structure that might express Pax7 (cites Pax7 in paraphysis of Pleurodeles and chick).
records.as_cited_in: Surfaced via WebSearch (AI summary lead); bibliographic data and text confirmed through PubMed/PMC

records.title: Conserved localization of Pax6 and Pax7 transcripts in the brain of representatives of sarcopterygian vertebrates during development supports homologous brain regionalization
records.authors: Moreno N, Joven A, Morona R, Bandín S, López JM, González A
records.query: PubMed: Moreno N[Author] AND Pax7 AND telencephalon; PMC full-text read
records.excerpt: Regarding the presence of Pax7 cells in the rostral prosencephalon, only a conspicuous labeling was identified in the paraphysis, mainly in anamniotes, in relation to the choroid plexus that extended between the telencephalic hemispheres.
records.note: Abstract does not name the paraphysis; PMC full text reports conspicuous Pax7 labeling in the paraphysis (mainly anamniotes, six sarcopterygian species incl. lungfish) as the only rostral-prosencephalic Pax7 signal, next to the telencephalic choroid plexus.

records.note: Companion adult Pax6/Pax7 map (anuran) to the developmental Pax7 paper and to Joven 2012/2013 in Pleurodeles; abstract does not name the paraphysis and full text was not available to check.

records.title: Pax6 and Pax7 in the Central Nervous System of Cladistian Fishes: A Comprehensive Expression Analysis
